**TASKS: Record tickets or issues related to product or service

- [ ] Log the type of the issue - a support ticket or bug or feature.
- [ ] Assign the bug and review the resolution, assigned the component and area of the issue
- [ ] Forked branch to fix the issue
- [ ] Fixed and tested the solution
- [ ] Sent a pull request for review and merge into the release branch
- [ ] Updated the issue to Dome status
